title: Mysterious Circumstances (BBC)
identity_notes: Mysterious Circumstances is a BBC Transcription Service package, not one continuous domestic series. Research describes a 26-play half-hour package assembled from BBC productions made across decades, including plays first broadcast under other BBC titles or services. The frozen GRH subset contains 20 distinct recordings: 17 already dated, Shadow of a Magnitude recovered to 1978-01-30, and two recordings whose original dates remain unresolved.

eras.label: Early source-production cluster
eras.notes: Frozen subset is dominated by BBC source productions from 1958-63; several were originally broadcast under Mystery Playhouse or other BBC strands.

eras.label: Later source-production cluster
eras.notes: Later plays were drawn into the same Transcription Service package despite originating years apart.

eras.label: Late package-era production cluster
eras.notes: The Drowned Village anchors the frozen late period; package histories extend the broader anthology through at least 1989.

historical_context.title: BBC Transcription Service Mysterious Circumstances package
historical_context.description: Mysterious Circumstances grouped 26 half-hour mystery/thriller plays for overseas distribution, drawing from BBC productions made across decades.

historical_context.title: Cross-service BBC source origins
historical_context.description: Source plays originated across multiple BBC services/strands rather than one continuous domestic series.

historical_context.title: Partial circulating preservation of a larger package
historical_context.description: The documented package contains 26 plays; Wade’s frozen subset contains 20 distinct playable objects, including two distinct Markheim productions.

historical_context.title: Mystery Playhouse source productions regrouped
historical_context.description: Several frozen plays, including The Demon King, The Dancing Partner and The Lady on the Grey, were originally broadcast under Mystery Playhouse before later package grouping.
